content: Vurya̱ntya vanu̱tya ratyadodaju̱ vu̱y
Saratyanuma̱ ji̱ta Crístu vu̱y, vurya̱tidye vichasara ratyanusavay variy. Jirya̱vanu̱tya daryaju̱ variy raju̱ ratyadodayu; ne ji̱rya̱sabuy ju̱na̱y riva Muyisésibe niquejada jto̱tadeda nu̱day.

Jirya̱ntya jnu̱y, rañi̱ rañi̱cha Pávuruntiy, jiryatiy ri̱tay jiryiva: Jiryetyi jmutyonutaniyu, sa̱tidye jtay Ju̱denu variy samivye jirye, jiryi̱tay variy rata: Ne rasa̱ra̱ vu̱jyu̱ra Crístu diiyada vu̱ryamityanicha̱daju̱ nu̱day. Ne vana̱y sa̱jantyuy Crístu variy jiryiva nu̱day.
Ra̱jatyi tu̱choda vijyo̱mujache jiryivantiy: Ni̱tiy jmutyonutaniyu, sa̱dyetya jto̱tanirya Muyisésibe niquejada ti̱ta̱ju̱ variy jiryamityanicha̱daju̱.
Jiryetyi jto̱taniryu̱rya niquejada, sa̱tidye jtay Ju̱denu samivye variy jirye, jirye̱cha variy jiintyasavay Crístusa̱siy, ne vana̱y sa̱sa̱y mitya variy jiryerya ju̱na̱reju̱ jnu̱yada nu̱day.
Su̱ntumusiy ji̱ta vu̱yntuy jaryi vu̱ñi̱ru̱yadamu ra̱jiju̱ jiryatiy sa̱jtay Ju̱denu samivyevyu̱y, jiryatiy vu̱tyuva̱chu daryaju̱ simu.
Jesucrístumu ji̱ta vu̱ñi̱cha samivye varityi vu̱dyityanura vu̱tyuva̱choda jiryatiy vuryivaayada jaryi vu̱vya̱ta̱damura, dañuma vurye̱cha jmutyonusavay, dañumamu̱y ne.
Jirye ji̱ta vichaniñu̱yada samiy munatya. ¿Chi̱ra paru̱tyaniy riva si̱tenu tuva̱choda jirye, chi̱?
Tama̱ Ju̱denumusiy rani̱cha paru̱yada day, tama̱. Ni̱ni̱ ji̱ta natuchara tuva̱chodamu vu̱y.

Jirya̱ntya jnu̱y ra̱jisiy taji datyadoda, daryatiy jiryi̱nu̱y pasidyeramusiy rijeryenura varapu buya̱dinube, racasiyadaju̱, daryaday rajaryenu nicyara̱y tu̱chodantirya samitu̱chodantiy, ra̱jarapu̱y samitu̱choda variy.
Jiryatiy ratyuva̱chu simu Vu̱yntyityu̱, radyetya variy jiryenchiy: Ne jirya̱jachipiya̱ru̱y tajiñe̱cho̱ju̱; sa̱day murichenutaniy Ju̱denuni̱ ni̱tiy jarupantaru̱y jirye, dañuma sa̱cha ti̱.

Ritaja̱nu ji̱ta variy jirye, ratyeryi̱veda: Raryityi datyanura jmutyonutadeda, daryatiy ru̱tañu̱y tavay rañijyu̱, ¿ta̱raju̱ riyasanta variy mitya riva ray, ta̱raju̱? Nevidye jiryatiy radyetyanusara darya: Vu̱ryamitya vinu jiryatiy sabatyeda Crístu crusitya̱sa vuryeyadaju̱, vinu rani̱ radyetyanu day. Ne rirrachuru̱rya crusinchiy datyadoda raryityi datyadodara jmutyonutadeda variy risa̱ju̱.
¡Jaryiñi̱ riryi jmutyonutaniryu̱y jirye! ¡Rirya̱ma̱ jmyisityasara variy risa̱ju̱yu!

Jirya̱jnu̱y, ratyeryi̱veda, sanatuyada Ju̱denu jirye ratyanusavajyu̱, jirya̱tidye jmu̱tya nu̱ñi jiryedyeyu, jiryevya̱ta̱damu. Ne vurya̱jvaay vu̱ryetyadodamura va̱cha ni̱ru̱yada, daryatiy vu̱ñi̱ru̱y vu̱dyirya day.
Tapi vuryito̱taniy ti̱ta̱ju̱ra Ju̱denu jteda, varityi vuryito̱tanirya jirya niquejada:

content.text: Vurya̱ntya va̱tani̱ vu̱tyuunu vichi̱ nu̱tyu vu̱vya̱ta daryantidyevyu̱y.

content: Netimyu̱ ne jiryevya̱tayu, jiryechu̱y nta nu̱ñi jiryeyu, jiryi̱myimyu̱y variy nu̱ñi jirye risa̱ju̱yu, jatyi jiryepyarutamu̱y tamityayu.
Va̱cha ni̱ru̱yadacanumiy vu̱ñi̱cha vu̱dyirya jvaayadamu
Ri̱tay ji̱ta variy: Jirya̱ntya vichasara Ju̱denu Jnutumu, ne jirya̱jvaay varirya jiryedyirya ni̱ru̱yada nu̱day.

Tapi jiryatiy vu̱ñi̱ru̱y vu̱dyirya darya, rani̱ ji̱ta ra̱cha Ju̱denu Jnutu jiyaro̱ju̱ day; Ju̱denu Jnutu ni̱ru̱rya ji̱ta, vu̱dyirya ni̱ru̱yada jiyaro̱ju̱ntidye; ramutimyu̱ ne vana̱y nta vuryivaarya si̱tenu vu̱ñi̱ru̱yada.
Varityi vu̱vyichasara Ju̱denu Jnutu datyadodamu, ne ra̱vuunu niquejada variñu̱ndyevyu̱y, jiryatiy Su̱ntumusiñuma vuryito̱taniy daryaju̱ darya.

Jvadichara jiryi̱nu̱rya vu̱dyirya ni̱ru̱yada day: ti̱ vaturu̱jsa̱ rupiyada, va̱cha jvaayada jarye, cadnaveda, jiipu tera jvaachi̱ nijyu̱ jachipiya̱jada risa̱ju̱, nuvoda, mityasiiyada, jvatyiyada, ra̱tya̱da, nique̱yada, mitya vu̱ñijyu̱ jachipiya̱jada jarye, tajiñe̱cho̱ju̱ jachipiya̱jada jaryentiy, tajiñe̱cho̱ju̱ datyadoda, ju̱nnuva̱yada, nijya̱mi̱ ju̱vedacanuyada jarye risa̱ju̱ntiy, niyu̱yadacanuyada, vaturu̱jsa̱ jarupadodacanuyada jarye, ti̱ta̱ju̱ darya jvaayada jarye risa̱ju̱ra. Ratyu̱choda ta̱riy ra̱jisiy jiryiva, ratyu̱chu ju̱na̱y ra̱jisiy jiryivantiy, tapi rityi jvaacharara darya jvaayada, ne rirya̱jmutya̱ra jiyaru̱rya Ju̱denu nusu̱jyomu.
Samirya ni̱ru̱yadacanuvye vu̱ryicha Ju̱denu Jnutumusiy

Ju̱denu Jnutu jvaayadamusiy ji̱ta vu̱dyetyara va̱ta̱da; ramusintyirya jchana̱yadantiy, samirya vicha̱da, tapi vicha̱da tavañijyu̱, samirya jachityavay vicha̱da jarye, samirya jvaayada tavay jiyadaju̱, paru̱yasa̱ jvaayada, nique̱yasa̱ vichasa̱da jarye, vase jachipiya̱jada jarye risa̱ju̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱. Ne tara ju̱na̱y ra̱cha tara niquejada rayaro̱ju̱ jadchiñu̱day, darya jvaayada jiyaro̱ju̱ nu̱day.
Vu̱y ji̱ta jiryatiy Jesucrístu nijya̱nvadyevyu̱y, vuryi̱vattama̱ sacrusitya̱sa vu̱dyirya ni̱ru̱yadajisivyu̱y.
Jiryatiy jnu̱yasavay Ju̱denu Jnutumusidyevyu̱y, vurya̱ntya vichasara sadatyadodamuju̱ntiy.
Ne vurye̱cha vuryinnuva̱vye, ne yinu̱y vu̱jyo̱ta rata riy vu̱tyevay, rirya̱mirye varivyu̱y.
